action.target: Cargo cargo vendor documented output and offline behavior
action.result: Verified from the pinned official Cargo command documentation that cargo vendor materializes crates.io and git dependencies into a local directory and prints the configuration needed to use the vendored source. The command documents --offline and --frozen, but offline operation depends on locally available dependency/index data. This is useful component evidence, not end-to-end Chat parity.

tested_scope: One pinned rust-lang/cargo documentation file only; no second public source, no Cargo execution, no network/build experiment.
scope_guard: Does not prove dependencies are already cached, cargo vendor is executable from scheduled Chat, a build is fully offline, or richer-mode outcome parity.
exact_continuation: After fresh required-control bootstrap and SHA-only freshness validation, read only current open_source LATEST, then perform exactly one official rust-lang/cargo pinned-commit lookup for doc/book/src/commands/cargo-fetch.md at commit 7941be6fb416b4cd9666aef7b858dfea25587a8c. Use that single unit only to verify whether cargo fetch pre-downloads project dependencies and how its locked/offline behavior constrains preparing the local cache needed by no-network cargo vendor, without adding a hosted-runner, Codespaces, artifact/LFS/package, cloud-credit, or user-execution dependency. Do not fetch a second public source or execute Cargo in the same invocation. Persist and exact-read back role-local checkpoint plus immutable receipt, then return recurring-open.
